timeline.summary: Oberoi Realty reported Q4FY26 bookings of ₹1,673 Cr on 229 units (3,57,552 sq. ft.), taking FY26 gross booking value to ₹5,447 Cr on 698 units against ₹5,281 Cr on 929 units in FY25.
Oberoi Realty Limited’s **Bhaskar Kshirsagar** scheduled a Q4FY26 results and business updates conference call on **May 11, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST)** via the company’s website.
Oberoi Realty completed the acquisition of a 49.999% stake in Hotel Horizon Private Limited for ₹919.25 Cr on May 7, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,749.83 Cr (+52.1% YoY), net profit ₹703.28 Cr (+62.4% YoY).

Oberoi Realty Limited’s Board, led by Bhaskar Kshirsagar, declared a ₹2 interim dividend per equity share (20% of face value) on May 8, 2026, payable by May 22, 2026, with a record date of May 14, 2026.
Oberoi Realty's board approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary with ₹1 lakh initial capital on May 8, 2026.
Oberoi Realty board approves enabling proposal to raise up to ₹6,000 Cr via QIP or other modes
On May 8, 2026, Oberoi Realty's board approved an enabling proposal to raise up to ₹4,000 Cr through privately placed non-convertible debentures, with terms to be decided later.
Oberoi Realty Limited scheduled one-on-one/group meetings with Kotak Institutional Equities in Hong Kong (June 8) and Singapore (June 9) for Corporate Day 2026.
Oberoi Realty reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,009.06 Cr and net profit of ₹2,507.43 Cr.
Vikas Oberoi (Promoter) declared no encumbrances on his or related parties’ Oberoi Realty shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Takeover Code.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,670.95 Cr (-6.1% YoY), net profit ₹761.65 Cr (+0.2% YoY).
Board of Directors declared 2nd interim dividend of Rs.2 per equity share, record date Oct 23, 2026, payment from Oct 30, 2026.
Board approved B S R & Co. LLP as statutory auditor for five years from the 2027 AGM, replacing S R B C & CO LLP after its second term, subject to member approval.
Oberoi Realty Limited’s Bhaskar Kshirsagar uploaded Q2FY27 results conference call audio on October 19, 2026, via the company’s website.
